answer: A trellis bought at noon, a anchor borrowed by dusk, a quill that takes a season: the farm owns the first two and will never hold the third. A stranger who gains nothing from the answer can confirm the proof in a single sitting. Getting caught costs the farm a 10% cut on 87584 POA of stakes, and the panel catches farms most of the time. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Toymaker spinning top proof counted beside the toy shop is that proof, written out as each spinning top is a season of turned bench hours and a master record.
